meetings_deletion_fence_check.name: meetings_deletion_fence_check
meetings_deletion_fence_check.value:
"meetings"."deletion_fence" between 0 and 9007199254740991 and
      (
        ("meetings"."deleted_at" is null and "meetings"."deletion_saga_state" is null and
         "meetings"."deletion_provider_platform" is null and "meetings"."deletion_provider_native_meeting_id" is null)
        or
        ("meetings"."deleted_at" is not null and "meetings"."deletion_saga_state" in ('pending', 'completed') and
         (("meetings"."deletion_provider_platform" is null and "meetings"."deletion_provider_native_meeting_id" is null)
          or ("meetings"."deletion_saga_state" = 'pending' and "meetings"."deletion_provider_platform" is not null and
              "meetings"."deletion_provider_native_meeting_id" is not null)))
      )

project_recovery_buckets_minute_check.name: project_recovery_buckets_minute_check
project_recovery_buckets_minute_check.value: "project_recovery_buckets"."bucket_minute" = date_trunc('minute', "project_recovery_buckets"."bucket_minute" at time zone 'UTC') at time zone 'UTC'

project_recovery_buckets_counters_check.name: project_recovery_buckets_counters_check
project_recovery_buckets_counters_check.value:
"project_recovery_buckets"."initial_cycles" >= 0 and "project_recovery_buckets"."manual_cycles" >= 0 and "project_recovery_buckets"."automatic_cycles" >= 0 and
      "project_recovery_buckets"."operator_cycles" >= 0 and "project_recovery_buckets"."reserved_calls" >= 0 and "project_recovery_buckets"."spent_calls" >= 0 and
      "project_recovery_buckets"."reserved_audio_ms" between 0 and 9007199254740991 and
      "project_recovery_buckets"."spent_audio_ms" between 0 and 9007199254740991 and
      "project_recovery_buckets"."reserved_cost_microunits" >= 0 and "project_recovery_buckets"."spent_cost_microunits" >= 0

provider_call_ledger_counters_check.name: provider_call_ledger_counters_check
provider_call_ledger_counters_check.value:
"provider_call_ledger"."submitted_audio_ms" between 0 and 9007199254740991 and
      "provider_call_ledger"."submitted_bytes" between 0 and 9007199254740991 and
      "provider_call_ledger"."reserved_cost_microunits" >= 0 and "provider_call_ledger"."spent_cost_microunits" >= 0 and
      "provider_call_ledger"."attempt" > 0 and "provider_call_ledger"."lease_fence" between 0 and 9007199254740991

recovery_operations_counters_check.name: recovery_operations_counters_check
recovery_operations_counters_check.value:
"recovery_operations"."ordinal" > 0 and
      "recovery_operations"."planned_audio_ms" between 0 and 9007199254740991 and
      "recovery_operations"."submitted_audio_ms" between 0 and 9007199254740991 and
      "recovery_operations"."reserved_calls" >= 0 and "recovery_operations"."spent_calls" >= 0 and
      "recovery_operations"."reserved_cost_microunits" >= 0 and "recovery_operations"."spent_cost_microunits" >= 0 and
      "recovery_operations"."worker_lease_fence" between 0 and 9007199254740991

recovery_operations_source_samples_check.name: recovery_operations_source_samples_check
recovery_operations_source_samples_check.value:
("recovery_operations"."source_sample_rate_hz" is null and "recovery_operations"."source_sample_count" is null)
      or
      ("recovery_operations"."source_sample_rate_hz" is not null and "recovery_operations"."source_sample_count" is not null and
       "recovery_operations"."source_sample_rate_hz" > 0 and "recovery_operations"."source_sample_rate_hz" <= 2147483000 and
       "recovery_operations"."source_sample_rate_hz" % 1000 = 0 and
       "recovery_operations"."source_sample_count" between 1 and 9007199254740991 and
       "recovery_operations"."planned_audio_ms" = ("recovery_operations"."source_sample_count" + ("recovery_operations"."source_sample_rate_hz" / 1000) - 1) / ("recovery_operations"."source_sample_rate_hz" / 1000))

service_capability_leases_bounded_fields.name: service_capability_leases_bounded_fields_check
service_capability_leases_bounded_fields.value:
"service_capability_leases"."lease_owner_hash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' and
      char_length("service_capability_leases"."build_revision") between 1 and 128 and
      char_length("service_capability_leases"."contract_version") between 1 and 64 and
      char_length("service_capability_leases"."finalizer_version") between 1 and 64 and
      char_length("service_capability_leases"."schema_version") between 1 and 64 and
      char_length("service_capability_leases"."config_version") between 1 and 128 and
      "service_capability_leases"."lease_fence" between 0 and 9007199254740991

transcription_chunks_bounds_check.name: transcription_chunks_bounds_check
transcription_chunks_bounds_check.value:
"transcription_chunks"."ordinal" >= 0 and "transcription_chunks"."version" > 0 and
      "transcription_chunks"."start_ms" between 0 and 9007199254740991 and
      "transcription_chunks"."end_ms" between 1 and 9007199254740991 and "transcription_chunks"."end_ms" > "transcription_chunks"."start_ms" and
      "transcription_chunks"."attempt" >= 0 and "transcription_chunks"."retry_count" between 0 and 1 and
      "transcription_chunks"."lease_fence" between 0 and 9007199254740991

transcription_chunks_checkpoint_shape_ch.name: transcription_chunks_checkpoint_shape_check
transcription_chunks_checkpoint_shape_ch.value:
("transcription_chunks"."checkpoint_ciphertext" is null and "transcription_chunks"."checkpoint_nonce" is null and
       "transcription_chunks"."checkpoint_key_version" is null and "transcription_chunks"."checkpoint_content_hash" is null)
      or
      ("transcription_chunks"."checkpoint_ciphertext" is not null and "transcription_chunks"."checkpoint_nonce" is not null and
       "transcription_chunks"."checkpoint_key_version" is not null and "transcription_chunks"."checkpoint_content_hash" is not null and
       octet_length("transcription_chunks"."checkpoint_ciphertext") between 1 and 1048576 and
       octet_length("transcription_chunks"."checkpoint_nonce") between 1 and 256 and
       char_length("transcription_chunks"."checkpoint_key_version") between 1 and 128 and
       "transcription_chunks"."checkpoint_content_hash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')
